full_prompt_en: A square mixed media collage places a grayscale young woman's head and shoulders among black triangles, pale washes, and a textured gold circle on a clean off white page. Her face sits slightly left of center, turned toward the right, with dark eyes looking just beyond the frame. Dark hair is pulled back loosely, and fine strands soften the outline near the cheek. A high dark collar and the cropped shoulder form a solid wedge across the lower middle. Behind the upper right side of her head, a mustard gold disk with mottled paper texture rises like a simple halo. Translucent gray and dusty pink rectangles float behind the hair and neck, while faint vertical rules and tiny grid fragments appear toward the left margin. A large black triangle cuts across the lower part of the portrait, its apex rising beside the cheek; smaller black and ocher triangles echo it farther left. At the right of the face, a black circular fragment and short horizontal bar balance the pointed shapes. Along the lower edge, gray watercolor like clouds and a strip of rough rocky texture partly obscure the dark shoulder. The white margins remain generous at the top and sides, giving every overlapping piece room to register. Fine photographic texture defines the face, while the geometry stays flatter and more opaque; splashes, smudges, and faint scratches connect the two surfaces. Light on the face is soft and frontal, producing delicate gray modeling without a strong cast shadow. The overall composition is poised and contemporary, using a limited warm accent palette to set expressive photographic realism against crisp abstract geometry.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介拼贴将灰阶年轻女子的头肩放在黑色三角、浅色洗痕和带肌理的金色圆盘之间，底面是一张洁净的灰白纸页。她的脸位于中央略左，转向右侧，深色双眼望向画框之外。深色头发松松地束在后面，细发丝柔化面颊附近的轮廓。高高的深色衣领与被裁切的肩部在下方中间形成坚实的楔形。头部右上后方，一轮带斑驳纸张肌理的芥末金色圆盘升起，如简洁的光环。半透明灰色和灰粉色矩形浮在头发与脖颈后面，左边距附近还有隐约的竖线和细小网格碎片。一枚大的黑三角切过肖像下部，尖端在面颊旁升起；更左方有较小的黑色与赭金色三角形呼应。脸的右侧，一个黑色圆形碎片和短横条平衡尖锐形状。下缘，灰色水彩般的云状色痕和一条粗糙的岩石纹理部分遮住深色肩膀。顶部与两侧留着宽裕白边，让每个叠片都有辨认空间。细腻摄影纹理刻画面孔，几何图形则更平整、更不透明；飞溅、擦痕和浅浅的刮迹连接两种表面。落在脸上的光柔和而正面，形成细致灰阶塑形，没有强烈投影。整体构图端正而当代，以有限的暖色重音将富有表情的摄影真实感与清晰的抽象几何并置。
style_prompt_en: Mixed media collage combines finely textured grayscale imagery with opaque black geometry, translucent pale overlays, and restrained metallic ocher accents. Circular and triangular fields overlap at different scales, setting curved continuity against abrupt angular breaks. A few narrow rules, tiny grid marks, and scattered specks supply delicate counterpoint to the broad flat shapes. Soft smudges and watery gray edges extend beyond otherwise crisp cut boundaries, so the composition alternates between precision and erosion. The darkest mass stays compact near the center, while generous off white margins preserve an open, airy frame. Low contrast gray modeling gives selected areas depth; the colored accents remain flat and luminous rather than becoming realistic light sources. Layer opacity shifts are visible where underlying tones show through. The overall effect is balanced and editorial, with sparse gold warmth sharpening the relation between photographic detail and abstract paper shapes.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介拼贴将细腻的灰阶影像与不透明黑色几何、半透明浅色覆层及克制的金赭色重音结合。大小不同的圆形与三角形色域彼此重叠，以连续曲线对照突然的棱角切断。少量窄线、细小网格痕与散落点迹为宽阔平色形状提供精细的反衬。柔和擦抹与水感灰色边缘越过原本清晰的裁切边界，使构图在精确与侵蚀感之间交替。最深的体块紧凑地停留在中央附近，宽裕的灰白边距则维持开阔通透的画框。低对比的灰阶塑形给选定区域带来纵深，彩色重音保持平坦而明亮，不变成写实光源。底层色调透过覆盖层显现之处，可见不透明度的变化。整体效果均衡且富有编辑设计气质，稀疏的金色暖意强化了摄影细节与抽象纸形之间的关系。
theme_en: Grayscale young woman layered with gold circles and black triangles
theme_zh: 灰阶年轻女子与金色圆形、黑色三角形叠合
name: Elisabeth Fredriksson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
